title: X-Chain Gaming NFT Marketplace
tagline: Unlock limitless possibilities with our Cross-Chain Gaming NFT Marketplace - Where every NFT is a masterpiece Game Asset waiting to be discovered.
description:
A X-Chain Gaming NFT Marketplace is built for users to earn through their In-game assets .

Features

1> Take your NFT's across Multiple Chains and even to Scroll powered by Hyperlane.

2> Take the advantage of fast zk-rollups by bridging your assets trust lessly via connext's Nft hashi Bridge .
how_its_made:
The project is powered by Hyperlane , Connext , Scroll . Build to scale and provide users with a single destination Marketplace to earn from their in game assets.

Since the transactions in blockchain need to be fast for best user experience , it becomes inevitable to switch to zk-rollups like scroll . 

The project provides a clean UI for the users to bridge their NFT's and tokens across Multiple Chains like Gnosis , Scroll , Taiko , Mantle .

2 Bridges are implemented in the marketplace 

i . Hyperlane for bridging to roll-up chain like scroll and sending interchain Message across multiple chains.

ii. While Connext Bridge utilises NftHashi to bridge the Nfts across 3 chains gorelli , mumbai and Optimism Goerli
